digest.component_or_area: LLM gate run telemetry / usage logging
propositions: Gate runs compute loop-vs-breadth signal via failure_usage() but discard seven keys (tool_calls, tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, request_limit, tool_calls_limit, finish_reason) at the record write, leaving no durable trace for tuning decisions
Local operator gate runs with no REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var set produce no usage record at all, requiring instrumented reruns to answer basic questions about spend
Success-path runs never call the shape reducer and record no tool_calls, request_limit, tool_calls_limit, or duration, making failed runs the only recordable path
Gate operators lack actionable data to distinguish loop-driven exhaustion from genuine breadth exploration, preventing the loop-tuning advice in docs/llm-framework.md from being applied

The wiring job requires connecting existing SHAPE_FIELDS computation (already built in failure_usage) to the record write path, adding duration_s and ticket fields, and enabling a default sink at repo_root/.rebar/usage.jsonl for gate sessions
The retrieved summary must render tool_calls, tool_calls_distinct, and the ratio to make the loop-vs-breadth signal visible to operators, leaving the token/cost table unchanged
